title: pilosella onegensis subsp. glaucochroa
intro: Pilosella onegensis subsp. glaucochroa, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the sunflower family, is a subspecies of the Pilosella genus. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella onegensis subsp. glaucochroa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and therapeutic applications of this plant.
